card.name: Fish and sediment-quality citations
card.fires_on: Digits, commas and small words inside aquatic-toxicology texts, such as sediment quality assessments with USEPA citations, and fish-size statements like 'fish over 10 inches'.

modes.label: Fish size numbers
modes.description: The space or digit after 'over' in a statement about fish length.
modes.example: a lake may have a good density of crappie, but few fish over<< >>10 inches.

modes.label: Citation years and punctuation
modes.description: Digits or commas inside USEPA and author citations in sediment-quality reference lists.

card.writes: It suppresses fish names such as fish, salmon and tuna, so it lowers the chance of a fish word coming next.
card.plain: It fires in water-quality and sediment-toxicity text with citations, and it pushes the model away from predicting fish words next.
